title: Broken Retaining Wall
description: A thick limestone retaining wall with a central collapse, fractured ashlar, exposed rubble core and a debris fan.

review.notes: Round 3 (final). Fixed: a rubble core now shows in the broken courses. Still failing: every block is a clean white box with soft rounded edges, so the wall reads as soap or ice cubes (hero, closeup_upper); the rubble core is small rounded polyhedra with no mortar between them; the broken top blocks are smooth faceted wedges without fracture planes or secondary chips; weathering is only sparse grey smudges (closeup_base). Fix: crisp arrises with local chips, large-plane fracture faces with secondary chips on broken blocks, a dark lime mortar matrix around the rubble core, local grime at the foot and joints, and lichen on the weathered tops.
